judgment: A defensible and numerically passing undergraduate design under explicit assumptions; not demonstrated to be optimal, ready for construction or unconditionally compliant.

Low-glare product with manufacturer photometry and real native calculation.

limitations_and_priorities.issue: 186 fixtures pass; no fixture-count or mixed-output optimization comparison establishes minimum practical load.
limitations_and_priorities.action: Optional optimization only if needed after first draft review; cannot infer excess solely from count.

limitations_and_priorities.issue: 32 bench/circulation control zones are an academic proposal; programming, sensor coverage and accessory selection remain unverified.
limitations_and_priorities.action: Explain operation simply; confirm compatibility and commissioning before implementation.
